web_search.radient.access.note: access column for the Radient search provider; 'Radient' is a product name, never translated

web_search.radient.detail.note: one-line description of the Radient search provider row. Keep 'Tavily', 'Radient', '$0.01' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.detail_signed_in.note: the Radient row's description once the user IS signed in (the sign-in clause of web_search.radient.detail is dropped). Keep 'Tavily', 'Radient' and '$0.01' verbatim.

web_search.radient.credits_low.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.credits_low.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.sign_in_again.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.sign_in_again.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.radient.not_signed_in.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.radient.not_signed_in.note: Keep 'Radient', 'Radient Console' and the backticked command verbatim.

web_search.state.auto_radient.role: provider state word in `lop search list` and `/search`
web_search.state.auto_radient.tone: terse lowercase status word, matches existing words like 'auto free' / 'auto paid'
web_search.state.auto_radient.note: a short state word, shown in a column sized to the widest word (16 cells in English); 'Radient' is a product name. 'native' means the model vendor's own built-in web search. 'auto credits' = joined the chain automatically and billed to Radient credits; the column beside it already says 'Radient credits', so the word stays short.

'native' means the model vendor's own built-in web search. A LISTED Radient provider: in the priority order, billed to Radient credits. '(credits)' must match web_search.marker.credits.

web_search.meaning.auto_radient.role: legend explaining a state word in `lop search list` and `/search`
web_search.meaning.auto_radient.tone: terse lowercase clause, no final period
web_search.meaning.auto_radient.note: explains what the state word means for the user's next search; 'Radient' is a product name; 'legs' are steps of the search fallback chain.

web_search.marker.plan.role: marker after a provider name in the `chain:` line
web_search.marker.plan.note: '(plan)' = included in a subscription the user already pays for; '(credits)' = billed to Radient credits. Keep the parentheses.

web_search.marker.credits.role: marker after a provider name in the `chain:` line
web_search.marker.credits.note: '(plan)' = included in a subscription the user already pays for; '(credits)' = billed to Radient credits. Keep the parentheses.

web_search.marker.no_credits.role: marker after a provider name in the `chain:` line
web_search.marker.no_credits.note: '(no credits)' = the Radient leg is skipped because the account is out of credits. Keep the parentheses.

web_search.native.access_key.note: access column for a model vendor's native search that bills a pay-as-you-go model API key

web_search.native.access_plan_key.note: access column for a native search that serves through a subscription sign-in (plan) or an API key

web_search.native.access_key_signin.note: access column for a native search that accepts an API key or an OAuth sign-in, both billed

web_search.native.detail_key.note: one-line description of a native search provider row. {vendor} is a brand name (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Alibaba Cloud...), never translated.

web_search.native.detail_plan_key.note: one-line description of a native search row with a plan leg and a key leg. {vendor} is a brand name; {plan} is a product plan name (ChatGPT), never translated.

web_search.native.no_credential.role: web_search failure reason shown in the tool card and returned to the model (rendered in English for the model; translated for display)
web_search.native.no_credential.note: {vendor} is a brand name, never translated.

web_search.native.access_plan.note: access column for a native search served only by a subscription plan's credential (sign-in or the plan's own key); no pay-as-you-go billing

web_search.native.detail_plan.note: one-line description of a native search row funded by a subscription plan. {vendor} is a brand name; {plan} is a product plan name (GLM Coding Plan, Kimi Code plan), never translated.

web_search.native.detail_search_api.note: one-line description of a vendor's standalone search API (returns results directly, no model answer). {vendor} is a brand name, never translated.
